state.draw_order: for each dataset draw eps as shape (800,6) in variable order D,R,H,P,F,V, then draw eta as length 800; unused eta is still drawn
state.retained_indices: simulate recurrence steps 1..800; discard steps 1..200; retain steps 201..800

synthetic_generators.common_pair: Z[t]=0.60*Z[t-1]+eta[t]; H[t]=0.45*H[t-1]+0.70*Z[t-1]+eps[H,t]; V analogously; other variables null
synthetic_generators.global_common: Z[t]=0.60*Z[t-1]+eta[t]; X[j,t]=0.45*X[j,t-1]+0.55*Z[t-1]+eps[j,t] for all six variables

dataset_seed_mapping.algorithm: UTF-8 canonical string -> SHA256 -> first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian uint64
dataset_seed_mapping.freshness: calibration and evaluation strings are disjoint; evaluation raw datasets are shared across representations

representations.R1: z=(x-mean)/sqrt(mean((x-mean)^2)); ddof=0; if scale<=1e-12 output all zero
representations.R2: m=median; MAD=median(abs(x-m)); scale=1.482602218505602*MAD; even median averages central two values; if scale<=1e-12 output all zero
representations.R3: average ranks for ties; p=(rank-0.5)/n; clip p to [1e-6,1-1e-6]; statistics.NormalDist().inv_cdf(p)
representations.R4: winsorize at q=.01,.99 using NumPy method=linear; then R1 z-score with same zero policy
representations.application_order: apply to each full 600-point variable separately before lag alignment

rff.seed_mapping: Correlon-LX-v0.2.2|phase0R|representation=<R>|pair=<canonical_i>-<canonical_j>|lag=<lag>|side=<X_or_Y>; UTF-8 SHA256 first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian uint64

normalized_hsic.centering: column-center both n x 24 RFF matrices

lags.alignment: overlap only; no padding, wrap, interpolation, or extrapolation

null_calibration.operation: independently permute the 30 block orders of each transformed series; preserve within-block order
null_calibration.permutation_seed: Correlon-LX-v0.2.2|phase0R|null|replicate=<1-based>|series=<D/R/H/P/F/V>; UTF-8 SHA256 first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian uint64
null_calibration.statistic: maximum over all 15 pairs, seven lags, and both channels
null_calibration.threshold: sort 1000 maxima ascending and use one-based k=ceil(.95*(B-1))+1=951

evaluation.localization: target H-V is significant and has the unique maximum pair score; exact ties fail localization
evaluation.broad_global_mode: at least 8 of 15 pair scores are significant; suppress individual candidate labels

gate.phase_pass: at least 3 of 4 representations pass every per-representation gate
